name: Tower of Zenopus - Empty Room Contents

items.name: Stack of empty, splintered wooden crates, stenciled with the faded image of a squid
Barrel leaking stagnant, black water that smells of old brine
Heavy, rust-colored woolen blanket, crawling with moths
Cracked ceramic jug containing a sticky, sweet-smelling, and mildly poisonous alchemical residue
Bucket filled with rusted gears, cogs, and bent metal struts
Anatomical chart depicting the muscular system of an Ogre, with precise mechanical augmentations sketched over it in charcoal
Three-legged stool that wobbles precariously
Rack of empty glass potion vials, most of them shattered
Single, heavy leather boot, its sole caked in dried mud and something that looks like rust
Coil of brittle, frayed rope that will snap under any significant weight
Small, forgotten leather pouch tucked behind a loose stone, containing 12 silver pieces and a strangely shaped goblin tooth
Collection of preserved animal parts (lizard tongues, rat spleens, bat wings) in dusty jars, now completely dried out and useless as spell components
Collapsed wooden shelving unit, its contents long since rotted away
Set of rusted, iron manacles bolted to the wall
Cracked scrying mirror that only reflects a distorted, blurry image of the viewer
Child's wooden toy soldier, clutched in the hand of a human skeleton slumped in a corner
Tangled mess of copper wire, partially stripped of its insulation
Heavy, lead-lined box, approximately one cubic foot, that is completely empty. It feels unnaturally cold to the touch
Set of delicate, but rusted, surgical-looking tools: scalpels, forceps, and a small bone saw
Thick, leather-bound tome titled "Celestial Cartography," but all its pages have been fused together by moisture
Sturdy iron crowbar leaning against a wall
Broken clockwork bird that twitches a single wing when touched
Several large, stained canvas tarps, folded neatly on a shelf
Chipped ceramic basin containing a dried, dark purple stain
Wooden box filled with dozens of non-magical, cloudy quartz crystals of various sizes
Single, unlabeled potion at the back of a shelf. It glows with a very faint, pulsating blue light
Collection of pewter plates and goblets, all tarnished black
Heavy, grease-stained leather apron hanging from a hook
Small, locked iron chest. The lock is rusted shut and there is no key (contains only sand)
Stack of scrolls that turn out to be Zenopus's meticulously detailed (and wildly inaccurate) horoscopes for local villagers from a decade ago
Broken spyglass with a cracked main lens
50 feet of silken rope in excellent condition, coiled neatly in a dry, sealed box
Glass jar containing a preserved, two-headed cave rat floating in murky fluid
Sack of petrified, moldy lumps that might have once been goblin rations
Old, tarnished silver locket containing a faded portrait of an unknown human woman
Set of rolled-up blueprints detailing a complex, automated potato-peeling device. They are signed with the initials "T.G."
Shattered hourglass, the sand spilled out in a pile on the floor
Heavy iron flywheel with a broken axle, leaning against a pillar
Broken lantern with its glass panes smashed
Small cage with a rusted-open door, containing a tiny skeleton that looks vaguely hamster-like
Collection of different-sized glass lenses, most of them scratched or chipped

Half-burned logbook. The only legible entry reads: "Containment procedure v.9 failed. The Miasma corrodes brass fittings at an alarming rate. Must procure more reliable smuggler contacts for pure silver wiring."
Small, high-quality steel file, perfect for sharpening blades or working metal
Wooden flute that is warped and can no longer produce a clear note
Taxidermied cave badger, its glass eyes missing
Set of block and tackle, the ropes frayed but the pulleys still functional
Single iron key with a grinning skull for a head. It doesn't seem to fit any door in this room
Box of charcoal sticks for writing or sketching
Metal bucket half-filled with a black, viscous sludge that smells faintly of tar and decay
Heavy, non-magical book bound in reptile skin, titled "The Ecology of the Amedio Jungle," with several pages on venomous flora and fauna bookmarked
